function.arguments: {"result":{"summary":"材料包聚焦两种不可混并的偏振统计扫描：相位分布展宽与平均相位变化。原论文公开演示可编程空间DOP调制；本数据展示不同扫描中的测量模式，但单位与原始测量链细节仍需核实。","artifacts":[],"evidence":[{"source_id":"Ka8f86511774b3fc9","quote":"The DOP is a statistical degree of freedom that expands the space available for optical information encoding.","locator":"article body excerpt"},{"source_id":"Kb29a36a23ebf17df","quote":"By engineering the polarization statistics at the micrometre scale with a phase-only spatial light modulator, we realize more than 1,024 spatial modes with fully programmable SOP and DOP.","locator":"abstract"},{"source_id":"K585388fc68bab517","quote":"Effect of multiple scattering and speckle on the accuracy and noise of the computed Stokes parameters is discussed.","locator":"abstract"}],"claims":[],"limitations":["spread 数据缺少 acquisition uncertainty；没有独立重复，不能据此识别误差机制。","两扫描的DOP导出尺度不同；dphi单位需从原始方法核实。","搜索返回的基础偏振综述仅摘要可读，未取得独立教材全文。"],"next_actions":["核对原文补充方法与数据定义，确认dphi单位及DOP尺度。","将归一化Stokes方向向量与标量DOP的定义、采样/探测平均操作分开检查。"],"materials":[{"id":"M1","observation":"spread扫描102点；DOP导出约8.42至93.14（均值57.17，源尺度约0-100）。随dphi增大，预览点由dphi=0时93.14降至0.410时31.00。全扫描Stokes方向平方范数均值0.999993。","conditions":"SLM编程的偏振统计控制；源数据中的Fig.2a扫描。只有单一扫描曲线，不是独立重复。dphi单位尚未核实。","expectation":"若增加相位分布宽度使探测平均包含更多相互不同的偏振态，则观测到的部分偏振度可能降低；此为条件性预期，不是由本数据独立验证的定律。","expectation_basis":"源论文将DOP描述为时域、频域或空间统计集合中SOP变化的度量；具体方向还依赖被平均的分布与采样。","existing_explanations":"论文解释框架是通过空间光调制器工程化SOP统计以实现DOP调制。其他可能包括相位控制改变有效探测平均、空间/像素串扰或DOP标定比例变化。","unknowns":"dphi物理单位和分布定义；DOP估计的测量/平均窗口；曲线单调性及重复性；检测噪声与像素串扰贡献；不同dphi下SOP分布形状。","source_ids":["Ka8f86511774b3fc9","Kb29a36a23ebf17df"]},{"id":"M2","observation":"mean_phase扫描200点覆盖0至2π；DOP约0.697至0.871（源尺度约0-1，均值0.7951）。归一化S1,S2,S3方向平方范数均值0.999996，最小0.999982，最大约1。","conditions":"源数据Fig.2b独立扫描；平均相位控制。不可与M1原始DOP数值合并。","expectation":"若仅改变偏振态在Poincaré球上的方向而不改变态间统计混合度，归一化Stokes方向可随相位变化而DOP近似稳定；这是条件假设，平均DOP并不证明逐点稳定。","expectation_basis":"标准Stokes描述将偏振态方向与DOP标量分开；源论文也把DOP和SOP作为可分别编程的自由度。","existing_explanations":"平均相位扫描主要旋转或重定向SOP而维持统计DOP，符合独立调控解释；扫描中小幅DOP变化也可能来自系统误差或真实耦合。","unknowns":"相位周期边界处是否连续；逐点DOP变化与相位的关系；测量不确定度；方向转动是否按预设规律；DOP小幅波动是否显著。","source_ids":["Ka8f86511774b3fc9","Kb29a36a23ebf17df","K585388fc68bab517"]}],"sources":[{"id":"Ka8f86511774b3fc9","title":"Degree-of-polarization modulation for high-dimensional optical computing","url":"https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10891-z","access_level":"article body excerpt up to 50000 chars","local_path":"D1902cc4c1b22eb01a1f2","content_note":"原论文正文摘录，含DOP统计定义和研究动机；不是完整全文。","source_kind":"original_study","content_access":"excerpt","domain_relation":"direct","relevance_reason":"源论文提供对观测系统及DOP物理含义的直接解释。","supporting_quote":"The DOP quantifies the variation of the SOP in the temporal, spectral or spatial domain."},{"id":"Kb29a36a23ebf17df","title":"Degree-of-polarization modulation for high-dimensional optical computing","url":"https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10891-z","access_level":"indexed abstract only","local_path":"Db945102a2598453ee704","content_note":"原论文摘要，报告空间DOP调制和高维模式演示。","source_kind":"original_study","content_access":"abstract","domain_relation":"direct","relevance_reason":"明确记录论文的实验性主要结果。","supporting_quote":"Here we demonstrate spatial DOP modulation, thereby achieving control over a new degree of freedom of light."},{"id":"K585388fc68bab517","title":"Review of polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography and Stokes vector determination","url":"https://doi.org/10.1117/1.1483879","access_level":"indexed abstract only","local_path":"D1abf678019b52abef6ff","content_note":"偏振敏感OCT综述摘要，指出Stokes参数估计的噪声与散斑影响。","source_kind":"review","content_access":"abstract","domain_relation":"background","relevance_reason":"提供独立的偏振测量背景，提示Stokes估计的噪声和散斑可能带来不确定性；不等于本研究系统中的已知误差机制。","supporting_quote":"Effect of multiple scattering and speckle on the accuracy and noise of the computed Stokes parameters is discussed."}]}}
